# Finney UI text and interaction audit

Final actual-response acceptance: long current case replies show their exact
opening paragraph with an explicit **Read full response** disclosure for the
unchanged remainder. Short answers and historical replies are unaffected;
provenance and decision controls remain outside. Ten reply/source unit checks,
twelve desktop/mobile browser checks and the production build passed for this
last correction. Closed and expanded screenshots were inspected. Director
messages use **Director request** in source tabs and headings, avoiding accidental
invoice labels when private metadata is omitted from the public snapshot.

Date: 25 October 2026. Scope: every operating screen and the landing/sign-in entry. The owner's two screenshots are the primary failure evidence. This is a redesign of the operating flow, preserving the receipt identity, mint palette, actual financial controls and source records.

## Finding

The old screen exposed the system's processing vocabulary before giving the director a situation to act on. The source preview dropped nested document bodies whenever a packet had a top-level description. A case upload reopened the entire generic workbench and asked the director to select the case again. Plain-text model output and machine identifiers occupied the primary reading area. This was an interaction failure, not a shortage of explanatory copy.

## Direction

The first screen answers: **What needs my decision at this event?** Hack Harbor is a dedicated owner-scoped synthetic practice event midway through planning. Its numbers come from the snapshot, not hardcoded UI totals. The walkthrough runs actual scoped commands and opens actual approval/report controls. Moving to the next tutorial step is navigation, never evidence of task completion.

The original receipt brand and Albert Sans remain. Operating body text is 16px, supporting labels have a 14px floor, and the first action leads. The walkthrough uses a short state transition with reduced-motion support. It is skippable and resumes per organization/run. Neither the tutorial nor the browser can promote a learned change.

## Complete surface inventory

| Surface | Problem / decision | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Landing | Distinctive identity already supplied. Financial and learning illustrations must remain labeled. | Preserve artwork and disclosures. Operating links open `/desk?demo=guided`; normal scoped desk links remain available. |
| Sign-in | Slogan plus paragraph explains an ordinary login. | “Sign in to Finney” and short event context. Keep actionable auth errors, email confirmation, and password requirements. Exact guided-entry flag survives login; arbitrary redirect URLs remain rejected. |
| Entry / Work | Blank composer and a case rail give no pre-context. | Guided entry creates/resumes the dedicated Hack Harbor scenario, displays its snapshot finances, and one immediate changed-invoice action. Existing owner event is not reset or overwritten. |
| Walkthrough | Passive page tours can suggest success without performing work. | Catch queues AV-specific prompt. Decide queues a real proposal prompt, then opens actual pending decision; rejection leads to a recovery prompt. Mira review precedes report generation. Learning inspection is optional. Startup remains disabled until scenario status is ready. |
| Navigation | Seven destinations plus extra helper paragraphs compete with work. | Retain clear functional destinations; remove the per-page explanatory paragraph. Primary context comes from the situation and case. |
| Work composer | Repeated permission/policy explanations, oversized entry controls. | Familiar task tabs remain for general work. Guided home keeps this secondary composer in a disclosure, with topbar Ask Finney opening and focusing it. Queue success names the state, not a UUID. |
| Case list | Synthetic prefixes and machine text compete with titles. | Human-readable titles; synthetic disclosure remains at scenario level. Version/time/status retained. |
| Case source | Packet description falsely substitutes for the evidence. | Render all nested document bodies, paragraphs, amounts and payment timing. Technical scaffold keys omitted from preview, full original artifact remains downloadable. React escapes content. Source receipt still binds org/run/source/version/path. |
| Source versions | Revised case links can omit predecessor from the UI. | Include superseded source IDs in the document history, label them Earlier, and keep current source first. Upload revision choices still use only current source IDs. |
| Case decision | Huge classification string, unstructured paragraph, raw identifiers. | Stable “Review ready” heading, structured amount and blockers, expandable full reasoning. No generated summary drops financial qualifiers. Full raw record remains inspectable. |
| Director conversation | Plain-text Markdown and consulted UUIDs dominate. | Escaped headings/lists/tables/paragraphs; long paragraphs separated without rewriting sentences. Consulted identifiers and provenance are disclosures. Newer replies still precede explicitly historical findings. |
| Add evidence | Generic workbench repeats task selection and case selection. | A case-bound upload surface with an explicit new-evidence/revision choice and accessible file dropzone. No redundant task tabs or case selector. Retry preserves the stored upload rather than duplicating it. |
| Budget | Approve/reject must remain explicit; money must not be confused with cash. | Preserve the real proposal and decision controls and allocation distinction. Increase small text; walkthrough sends proposal before opening decisions. |
| Payment review | UUIDs/hash occupy the main decision flow. | Move case ID out of primary action facts; exact action fingerprint remains in disclosure. Amount/destination/network and approval count remain visible. Exact-action checks unchanged. |
| Payment execution | Internal proposal/payment/job IDs overpower actual state. | Move linkage into Payment references disclosure. Keep wallet approval, chain confirmation and event approval distinct; no settlement inferred. |
| Approval policy | Dense copy has real consequences rather than describing the UI. | Retain consequences of policy changes and director-only control. This copy is necessary to make a meaningful financial decision. |
| Overview / opening cash | Unknowns and attested cash must not be flattened into attractive totals. | Preserve exact money/null semantics, cash attestation and immutable starting balance warning. Supporting text enlarged. |
| Reports | Generation versus completed report must remain distinct. | Preserve actual generation/download and cutoff. Walkthrough reaches reports after the Mira prompt and never invents an artifact. |
| Agent / learning | Internal IDs and evaluation setup overwhelm the outcome. | Lead with measured activation status, hide evaluation setup in Run an evaluation, remove eval UUID from heading. Actual cases/results/diffs/provenance remain. No promotion claim from completed jobs or candidate generation. |
| Activity | Machine payloads are useful for inspection, not initial reading. | Event names remain readable; payload remains in disclosure. Supporting metadata enlarged. |
| Connections | Permissions and mailbox ownership genuinely affect user choices. | Retain director-only mailbox explanation, unavailable/connected/worker states, and disabled personal-demo mailbox flow. No claim of all-inbox Gmail push. |
| Source register | Raw provenance is appropriate only as a secondary audit tool. | Keep under All source records, with private scoped downloads. Case preview is now the main reading surface. |
| Errors/loading/empty states | Long instructional text and technical queue IDs. | Simplify queue acknowledgments, keep real validation/recovery and uncertainty. Preparing scenario has disabled action; no simulated model progress. |

## Hyphenate proof in the flow

- **Real enough:** a realistic synthetic mid-event situation, actual versioned artifacts, live queued commands and stored results. Synthetic starting balances are labeled, not represented as bank-confirmed.
- **Would you hire it:** named vendor/organizer/sponsor work, director decides, rejected budget remains rejected, no automatic payment or fabricated settlement.
- **New:** agent investigates source changes, maintains obligations, accepts director input while running, and proposes separately tested procedure changes.
- **The moment:** revised AV amount; declined budget followed by a changed plan; personal-card purchase and duplicate receipt handled without double liability. These remain things to demonstrate with actual model behavior, not seeded model outcomes.

## Design references used

Impeccable’s local onboarding, operate, new-work and craft-floor guidance: context before ceremony, show real actions, progressive disclosure, readable text, purpose-driven motion. The public Impeccable source is https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable. Taste Skill’s app-screen guidance was consulted for financial data honesty and the screen’s one question; no random replacement brand was applied because the owner retained the existing receipt identity.

## Verification / limits

Meaningful tests cover nested evidence, escaped model text, contextual case binding, source-version race protection, actual walkthrough command payloads, preparing-state lockout, and skip/resume. Screenshot review uses the full Dashboard with explicit HTTP/storage fixtures at desktop and mobile sizes. These fixtures do not establish live backend/model success; root-owned hosted acceptance is separate. No payment or learning result is generated by the UI.

Initial implementation: typecheck, 62 unit checks, production build passed. Browser review receipt will be appended after the quiet model window.

### Final local verification

- Production build and TypeScript passed on the final operating UI.
- **64 unit checks passed**, including lossless long financial paragraphs (USD 2,500.00 / USD 420.00, UUID/version references), nested source packets, case-bound upload, and rejection isolation between Food and the guided AV proposal.
- Browser matrix: **43 passing checks, 11 explicit fixture/viewport skips**, resolved across the full run and targeted reruns. The reruns updated expectations for IDs now behind Payment references and verified the legacy landing JavaScript also routes to guided entry. No financial assertion was relaxed.
- Final guided Dashboard checks: **4/4** desktop/mobile, including exact catch/decide/Mira scoped command payloads, preparation lockout, skip/resume, no fabricated learning result, and the report continuation remaining visible after opening a case.
- Source version switching/late storage responses, actual upload predecessor payloads, stored-upload retry, budget proposal/decision separation, payment reconciliation linkage, and procedure artifact integrity checks passed.
- Opened and inspected all four captures from the final desktop/mobile batch. Files: `.impeccable/review/desktop-guided-home.png`, `mobile-guided-home.png`, `desktop-contextual-case.png`, `mobile-contextual-case.png`. These are explicit fixture screenshots, not hosted acceptance. Captures scroll to the document top; the first round's floating skip-link was a scrolled full-page capture artifact and is absent in the confirmation.
- Impeccable detector ran once: 308 advisory design-system drift findings (221 type-size, 65 color, 22 radius), no higher-severity findings. These compare the legacy two-size token header against the larger existing stylesheet plus the intentional redesign. The direction supplement records the new 16px body/14px supporting scale; unrelated skill-token repair was not added to this release.
- Review ownership: parent coordinator independently reviewed screenshots/code and requested the lossless paragraph regression, AV-only budget state, and visible report continuation; all three were addressed. No additional child reviewer was spawned under the coordinator's explicit no-extra-agents boundary.

Remaining hosted verification belongs to the coordinator: deployed sign-in/guided create/resume, actual worker outputs, actual director rejection/recovery, and reports. Local UI fixtures establish interaction correctness, not model competence or promotion. Case-specific queued/running labels additionally depend on the snapshot exposing a safe case/job association; the guided action itself observes scoped director-job state and avoids duplicate guided submissions while work is active.

### Hosted-schema correction

Actual hosted inspection exposed a fixture gap: source metadata is privacy-projected to `{}`, and the guided artifacts use `provider: guided_demo`, `external_id`, `headers.subject`, and `documents[].kind/text`. The original UI fixture supplied a filename and a different packet shape. Corrected the source header and document tabs to use the linked case title when a filename is absent, labeled guided sources Practice document, omitted technical `kind`/`external_id`, and rendered email headers without duplicate subject or Markdown scaffolding. From/To/Date and distinct Subject remain readable evidence.

The tests now load canonical `_INITIAL` and `_REVISED` literals directly from `app/guided_demo.py` through Python AST parsing, without importing the app or contacting providers. Every actual document body is asserted intact. The full Dashboard browser fixture uses the canonical revised packet with empty source metadata. Targeted acceptance: **12 unit checks and 10 desktop/mobile browser checks passed; production build and TypeScript passed**. Opened both updated case screenshots; title, actual full source and contextual upload render correctly. No other operating behavior changed in this batch.

### Actual model Markdown correction

A real hosted catch response placed `##` headings immediately before its comparison table and bullet lists, without blank lines. Replaced blank-line-only rendering with escaped line-block parsing for headings, tables, lists, paragraphs, code fences and italic emphasis. The financial content is not rewritten. A captured response with fictionalized record references is stored as a formatting fixture; its separately diagnosed simulation explanation is explicitly not a financial test expectation.

Verification: **15 targeted unit checks and 14 desktop/mobile browser checks passed**, plus production build/TypeScript. Tests assert the actual response structure, all monetary values and qualifiers, safe raw-HTML escaping, and no horizontal page overflow. Opened `.impeccable/review/desktop-actual-response.png` and `mobile-actual-response.png`: headings, comparison table, bullet lists and italic text render as intended. No style, authority or workflow change accompanied this correction.
